title: Attention Is All You Need - Paper Summary
text: The 2017 paper “Attention Is All You Need” by Vaswani et al. introduced the Transformer architecture, revolutionizing NLP.

title: Attention Is All You Need - Paper Summary
text: The 2017 paper “Attention Is All You Need” by Vaswani et al. introduced the Transformer architecture, revolutionizing NLP.

title: Attention Is All You Need - Paper Summary
text:
Key Contributions

Self-Attention Mechanism: Allows the model to weigh the importance of different words
Positional Encoding: Captures sequence order without recurrence
Multi-Head Attention: Enables learning different representation subspaces

title: Attention Is All You Need - Paper Summary
text:
Architecture
The Transformer consists of:

Encoder: Processes the input sequence
Decoder: Generates the output sequence
Attention Layers: Connect encoder and decoder

title: Attention Is All You Need - Paper Summary
text:
Mathematical Foundation
The attention mechanism is defined as:
\[
\text{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V
\]

title: Attention Is All You Need - Paper Summary
text:
Impact
This architecture became the foundation for: - BERT - GPT series - T5 - And many more modern language models

title: Attention Is All You Need - Paper Summary
text:
References
Vaswani et al. (2017). “Attention Is All You Need”. NeurIPS.

title: Introduction to Neural Networks
text:
What is a Neural Network?
A neural network is a computing system inspired by biological neural networks. It consists of interconnected nodes (neurons) organized in layers:

Input Layer: Receives the initial data
Hidden Layers: Process the information
Output Layer: Produces the final result
